## Watchgoose (Remote)

Watchgoose's hosted MCP server connects an AI assistant to one Watchgoose project so it can inspect cron and scheduled-job checks and their status history. Read-only access is the default and exposes `list_checks`, `get_check`, and `list_flips`. With explicit read-and-write consent, the assistant can also inspect recent signals and integration names and create, update, pause, resume, or delete checks.

**Authorization.** OAuth 2.1 authorization code flow with PKCE (S256) and Dynamic Client Registration; no API key is needed. The consent screen asks the user to pick one project and selects read-only by default. Connections can be revoked under Account settings > MCP Connections.

**Account.** Requires a Watchgoose account with access to at least one project. The free plan is enough; paid features are not required. Docs: https://watchgoose.com/docs/mcp/
